message: The other day, I found myself in a delightful debate with my grandson about whether thunderstorms were just nature’s way of showing off. Spoiler alert: they can be quite the show! I casually suggested he might want to know a bit more about what to do when the skies get dramatic, and lo and behold, here’s a handy guide to help us all stay calm when things get a little electrifying. It’s always nice to be prepared, wouldn’t you agree? What’s your favorite rainy day activity?
